A little about me.

I’m Jebickson Samuel, a developer working across web applications, real-time services, and cloud infrastructure. My projects bring together practical interfaces and the systems that power them, from stock market dashboards to event-driven sports commentary.

With Signalist, I explore market data, authentication, watchlists, and background workflows. Sportz focuses on reliable WebSocket connections and live updates. CloudNotes brings a Python API and managed AWS services together in a serverless notes application.

My work spans React and Next.js on the frontend, Node.js and Express for backend services, and Python on AWS Lambda. I use MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB for different data needs, with Git and infrastructure as code supporting the development process.

Field notes.

Signalist

Project experience
Full-stack developmentGitHub ↗

Signalist combines interactive market charts, company insights, and personal watchlists. Better Auth handles authentication, while Inngest coordinates background workflows for notifications and market digests.

Next.jsTypeScriptMongoDBInngest

Sportz WebSocket

Project experience
Real-time backend engineeringGitHub ↗

Sportz broadcasts match commentary and score updates to subscribed clients. The backend includes connection heartbeats, backpressure protection, rate limiting, and validation with Zod, backed by PostgreSQL and Drizzle.

Node.jsExpressPostgreSQLWebSocket

CloudNotes

Project experience
Serverless cloud developmentGitHub ↗

CloudNotes supports creating, reading, updating, and deleting notes. The API runs on AWS Lambda behind API Gateway, persists notes in DynamoDB, and uses AWS SAM for repeatable infrastructure deployments. The frontend is hosted on Vercel.

PythonAWS LambdaAPI GatewayDynamoDB
